lines.en: One hop, and spores scatter behind me.
Little short legs shuffling along.

lines.zh: 蘑菇人在前面，我紧跟上。
lines.en: The mushroom person is ahead. I keep up.
Hopping is faster than walking for me.
Rustle, rustle. I follow the sound.
My cap wobbles and spores drift up.
I glide along close to the ground.
My steps are light as falling leaves.
Where are you going? I'll follow.
I circle around you. Don't mind me.
A string of white dots on the mud.
I push forward brushing the grass.
I stand here, slowly puffing spores.
Cool beneath my mushroom cap.
When there's no wind, I just stare.

lines.zh: 我在等新的孢子长出来。
lines.en: I wait for new spores to grow.
The ground is damp. Lovely.
Why are you looking at me?
I stay still, like a tiny mushroom.
That rustle behind you is me growing.
This shade suits me.
I give my cap a little shake.

lines.zh: 等天黑？我不知道夜白天。
lines.en: Wait for dark? I don't know night from day.
I count my spores. One, two.
Hey, don't step on that one by my feet.
I'm a bit sleepy. Just a moment.

lines.zh: 一点雨落下来，我张嘴接。
lines.en: A drop of rain falls and I open my mouth.
I shake the spores off my cap.
Your face is so big.
Bend down. I'm talking to you.
You don't smell of fungus.
I can see your boots.
Don't be scared. I'm small.

lines.zh: 你先动手的话，我可会咬人。
lines.en: If you swing first, I will bite.
Even crouching, you loom over me.
I look up and my neck aches.

lines.zh: 我头顶的菌盖，还没长开。
lines.en: The cap on my head hasn't opened yet.

lines.zh: 一直看着，我孢子都乱了。
lines.en: Staring so long, my spores are in disarray.
You crouched down. What a tall person.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，帽子要掉了。
lines.en: I look up at you. My cap might fall off.

lines.zh: 你手里那根木棍是什么？
lines.en: What is that stick in your hand?
Don't measure my height with your boot.
Ouch, my cap.
You squashed me flat.
My spores are all scattered.

lines.zh: 孢子从伤口里漏出来了。
lines.en: Spores leak out of the wound.
Stop hitting me. I'm tiny.
I fall, then get back up.
Part of my cap has caved in.
My legs feel weak.
How could you do that?
My stem is bent and about to snap.
Is that a mushroom? Give it to me.
Your hands smell of fungus.
The mycelium is waiting in the soil.
Put it down. Just put it down.

lines.zh: 我这张孢子脸，是蘑菇人捏的。
lines.en: A mushroom man shaped this spore face.

lines.zh: 别逗我，我小小的腿追不上。
lines.en: Don't tease me. My little legs can't keep up.
Can I really eat this?
That piece in your hand, half a bite?
What are you eating? I want some.
I'm hopping up to grab it.
Ah, I've been knocked away.
My cap has been squashed flat.
I bounce into your heel.
Don't crowd me. I'm tiny.
Bump into me and you get spores on you.
I bumped your ankle.
We collide and both wobble.

lines.zh: 你肩膀碰掉了我的伞盖边。
lines.en: You knocked the edge of my cap.
I roll a good distance away.
Touch me and your skin will itch.
Spores are drifting over there too.
Shall we lean against each other?
Don't watch. It's embarrassing.
Two little mushrooms, drawing near.
The wind blew us together.
Our threads will join up.
By morning there'll be a few more here.
You're trampling our little corner.
The night is quiet. Good for talking.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，把孢子送过去。
lines.en: I shake, sending my spores over.
I've got this little thing.
So heavy. I'll balance it on my cap.
You dropped it? I picked it up first.
It's shiny. What is it?
I stuff it under my cap.
It's not a fungus, but I'll keep it.
I rolled over and hooked it.
Small enough to carry.
I stuff it under my cap.
I hug it to myself. No.
You're in the mushroom person's way.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，比走路快得多。
lines.en: I am much faster jumping than walking.
Don't run. I hop faster than you.
Right now. Don't hide.

lines.zh: 你不是蘑菇人，我要咬你。
lines.en: You are not the mushroom man; I will bite you.
My cap is aimed at you.
You stepped on our ground.
One hop and I'm there.
Hiding behind a tree won't help.
I'll let you taste my poison.
I hop up with venom on my teeth.
You stepped back. Perfect.
I keep to your heels.
You take one step, I take two hops.
Don't kick. I can dodge.
I've worked my way to your feet.
That rustling is me closing in.
There's a wide gap in your boots.
I hug the ground. You can't see me.
Just a bit closer and I can reach.
No hurry. My spores will drift over.
You looked down. Don't look for me.
I've cut off the way by the roots.
I follow the grass you trampled.

lines.zh: 我贴在你的鞋底，别想甩。
lines.en: I'm stuck to your sole. Can't shake me.
A bite, and it's poisoned.
I latch onto your ankle.
This one goes right through armor.
Ugh, your blood is salty.
The poison seeps into the bite.
I spring up and hit your knee.
Your hand went weak. I saw it.

lines.zh: 我的牙带着毒，咬你脚踝。
lines.en: My teeth are venomous, and they find your ankle.
You kicked at nothing. I'm at your feet.
A small bite, enough to make you sick.

lines.zh: 我从蘑菇丛底下钻出来。
lines.en: I pop out from under the mushroom patch.
My cap pushes the dirt aside.
Hey, I'm here.
A dewdrop woke me.

lines.zh: 我从蘑菇人身上掉下来。
lines.en: I fell off a Matango.
Did someone call me?
My threads twitch and I open my eyes.
I grew here, right here.
Spores fell, and became me.
I'm short and small. Don't underestimate me.
I push through the grass and poke my head out.
The mushroom person sent me to help.
I spin once to learn the way.
This soil suits me fine.
Fire scorches my cap.
A fall? I'm so light, it's fine.
Water fills my cap. I can't breathe.
A boom, and I'm blown into the air.
The arrowhead pierced my cap.

lines.zh: 咒语贴上来，我菌丝都缩了。
lines.en: The spell clings and my threads shrink back.

lines.zh: 土里没有养分了，我好虚。
lines.en: The soil has no nutrients left. I feel faint.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，焦了一片。
lines.en: Lightning hit me and scorched a patch.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我长不住。
lines.en: No soil in the void. I can't take root.
